newsitem.title: FRANCE: Police evict immigrants from Paris offices.
newsitem.headline: Police evict immigrants from Paris offices.

text.p: French riot police on Tuesday evicted more than a hundred illegal immigrants from a Paris police office they had occupied an hour earlier to demand residence permits and a halt to expulsions.
A police spokesman said 100 to 150 protestors had taken over a centre for foreigners in central Paris at mid-morning. A spokesman for the demonstrators said they numbered around 250.
The protest was called by a movement which says it represents some 800 people of 30 different nationalities.
Police said several protesters, including women with young children, were taken away in vans for checks at police headquarters.
This summer, some 300 Africans occupied a Paris church for two months, claiming controversial 1993 immigration laws had turned them into illegal immigrants.
The government granted residence permits to many of them on humanitarian grounds, but others are still waging court battles to avoid expulsion.
